Hey everyone, I figured one of the major advantages of voat compared to reddit is that posts stick around a lot longer, so we could get some meaningful discussion going on. So i'm just going to go through each of ness' moves, tips and tricks i'd love to see othere peoples thoughts!

Moves Neutrals Up - So i never really manage to get much usage with this move, but I think that's more of a problem with me than the move. A great option to cover the space above ness' head without having to commit to a short hop, and amazing at juggling the sandbag!!!

Side - Decent just for telling someone to GTFO but I would rather go for a jab in that case, so I really dont use this move at all

Down - Another spacing move, also decent for hitting someone who is on the ledge without invincibility!

Neutral - I love ness' jab, if someone is up in your face and you don't want them to be it gets them out, use this a lot.

Aerials Fair - I thik of this as ness' bread and butter move, IMO ness' air game is a lot better than his ground game, in the neutral game I love to just short hope fair to set up a wall against the more rushdown characters.

Dair - Never use this - unless i'm going for style spikes, honestly I think this represents ness' biggest weakness, it's SO hard to hit someone directly below you, and I swear dair has a longer start up time than it's hitbox is alive for.

Uair -This move is amazing and can kill SO early, a great mixup from dthrow combos. The biggest improvement in my ness game came from using this move more. The nastiest thing i've ever done is dthrow -> uair -> uair -> pk1 tail -> pk2 for a 0-death! Can't rate this move more highly.

Nair - Another great spacing tool, slaps people back if they come close great oos option. Also if i'm feeling risky i'll jump off the stage and edgeguard with this. People aren't usually expecting it and it can kill surprisingly early.

Specials Pk Thunder - IMPORTANT : You can use this twice against the walls!! If you press up-b JUST as your hitting the wall from pk2, you get another PK1! Super Super Good, add things like sonic springs and you sometimes get triplle PK recoveries. Ness has bad recoveries my buttcheeks!

Can also be used to cancel your momentum and grab the ledge when usually double jump doesn't let you grab it, but this is risky

PK Flash - Don't think I've ever used it, takes so long to come out it's just not worth it.

PK - Magnet - Not too much to say about this, only works for non - physical projectiles. Also slows down your fall speed so you can throw it in for mixups!

PK Fire - Don't Spam this move seriously!!! Use it for hard reads or when someone is hanging on the ledge without invulnerability! If someones dashing at you, then you can run away and pivot -> pk fire, really catches people off guard

If anyone has anything to add please comment!
